报平安并汇款给父母: Sending money and good news to parents
向父母报平安，告知已寄出汇款，叮嘱保重身体: Let your parents know you are well, tell them about a remittance and ask them to take care.
双亲大人膝下：\n敬禀者，拜别以来，倏经数月，念念！男在外一切安好，请勿挂念。兹:
My dear parents,
Months have flown by since we parted. You are always in my thoughts. I am well here, so please do not worry. I am sending one hundred dollars with this letter. Please check the sum and write when it arrives. Word from you would ease my mind. As the weather turns cold, please wear warm clothes and take care of yourselves. I wish you peace and good health.
Your son, Ah Fu, with deepest respect
I respectfully write, after our long separation…
双亲大人加衣珍重: Please wear warm clothes and take care of yourselves.
详细汇款并嘱托家用分配: Dividing a remittance among household needs
告知大额汇款，详细说明款项用途分配: Explain how a larger sum can cover family expenses and what to set aside.
双亲大人尊前：\n敬禀者，自别慈颜，转瞬几度星回，念念！客中粗适，堪慰锦注。兹逢:
My dear parents,
Several seasons have passed since I last saw your kind faces. I think of you often. I am getting on well here. With this post I send five hundred Hong Kong dollars. Please count it when it arrives. I leave its use in your hands: two hundred for Grandfather’s winter clothes and medicine, two hundred for household expenses and one hundred to keep for emergencies. I am far from wealthy, but I earn something each month. Please set your minds at ease. I wish you peace and health.
Your son, Ah Fu, with deepest respect
自别慈颜，转瞬几度星回: Several seasons have passed since I last saw your kind faces.
客中粗适，堪慰锦注: I am getting on well here. Please set your minds at ease.
兹逢便邮，特汇上港币伍佰大元: With this post I send five hundred Hong Kong dollars.
Set aside two hundred for Grandfather…
男在洋中虽无大财，然每月皆有进项: I am far from wealthy, but I earn something each month.
寄钱给妻子并问候家中: Sending money and family news to a wife
告知妻子汇款已寄出，嘱托照料家中老小: Tell your wife a remittance is on its way and ask after the older and younger members of the household.
贤妻妆次：\n启者，自别以来，时常挂念。外洋粗安，幸勿锦注。兹逢信局之便，寄上大:
My dear wife,
Ever since we parted, you have been on my mind. I am keeping well abroad. With this letter I send twenty silver dollars. Please check that they arrive safely. I leave things at home in your good hands. Mother is getting on in years, so please watch over her meals and her rest. Encourage the children to keep up their studies. Once the accounts are settled at year’s end, I may be able to come home. Until then, take good care.
Your husband, Ah Fu
启者，自别以来，时常挂念: Ever since we parted, you have been on my mind.
外洋粗安，幸勿锦注: I am keeping well abroad. Please do not worry.
家中诸事，望卿妥为照料: I leave things at home in your good hands.
待年终结算后，或许可回家团聚: Once the accounts are settled at year’s end, I may be able to come home.
简短报平安: A short note to say all is well
最简洁的报平安家书，适合定期寄送: A brief family letter for keeping in touch regularly.
双亲大人膝下：\n敬禀者，内外平安，请免介念。兹付去银信壹封，到祈查收示复。余事:
My dear parents,
All is well here, so please set your minds at ease. I enclose a remittance with this letter. Kindly check it and send word when it reaches you. I will write more another time. Wishing you peace and good health.
Your son, Ah Fu, with deepest respect
内外平安，请免介念: All is well here, so please set your minds at ease.
兹付去银信壹封: I enclose a remittance with this letter.
余事后陈: I will write more another time.
春节遥寄祝福: Lunar New Year greetings from afar
农历新年给家人的节日祝福和汇款: Send your family a New Year greeting and a gift of money.
双亲大人膝下：\n敬禀者，岁序更新，桃符换旧。遥想家中，想已一片新年气象。男远在:
My dear parents,
The year has turned and fresh charms hang on the doors. I picture the house getting ready for New Year. It weighs on me that I am abroad and cannot join you. I send thirty silver dollars as my New Year gift, with my warmest wishes. May the spring bring you both health, happiness and long life. I bow to you from afar and wish you a peaceful New Year.
Your son, Ah Fu, with deepest respect
岁序更新，桃符换旧: The year has turned and fresh charms hang on the doors.
未能回家团聚，殊深负罪: It weighs on me that I cannot join you at home.
寄上洋银叁拾大元，聊作年礼: I send thirty silver dollars as my New Year gift.
新春康泰，福寿绵长: May spring bring you health, happiness and long life.
叩贺新禧，顺请福安: I bow to you from afar and wish you a peaceful New Year.
中秋佳节，遥寄思乡之情与节日问候: Send Mid-Autumn greetings and share your longing for home.
双亲大人膝下：\n敬禀者，秋节又届，明月在天。古人云\"每逢佳节倍思亲\"，男今:
My dear parents,
Mid-Autumn has come again and the full moon hangs in the sky. As the old verse says, every festival makes us miss our loved ones all the more. Looking at the moon in a foreign land, I feel those words keenly. A few days ago I sent twenty dollars for mooncakes at home. If there is good fruit this year, could you send me a little? A taste of home would mean a great deal. Wishing you both good health.
Your son, Ah Fu, with deepest respect
秋节又届，明月在天: Mid-Autumn has come again and the full moon hangs in the sky.
每逢佳节倍思亲: Every festival makes us miss our loved ones all the more.
解释久未寄信的原因，表达歉意并报平安: Explain a delay in writing, ask forgiveness and reassure your family.
双亲大人膝下：\n敬禀者，久疏禀候，歉罪殊深。实缘客中俗务纷繁，加以邮便不便，以:
My dear parents,
Forgive me for letting so much time pass without a letter. Work has kept me busy and the post has been unreliable. I am well and my affairs are going smoothly, so please do not worry. I will write more often from now on, if only a few lines, to set your minds at ease. I wish you peace and good health.
Your son, Ah Fu, with deepest respect
久疏禀候，歉罪殊深: Forgive me for letting so much time pass without a letter.
俗务纷繁，加以邮便不便: Work has kept me busy and the post has been unreliable.
身体粗安，诸事顺遂: I am well and my affairs are going smoothly.
兹后当勤修寸禀: I will write more often from now on.
离家多年，深切倾诉对故乡和家人的思念: After years away, tell your parents how much you miss them and your hometown.
双亲大人膝下：\n敬禀者，自违慈范，瞬逾三秋。每忆家园风物，辄辗转不能成眠。日前:
My dear parents,
Three autumns have passed since I last saw you. When I think of home, I turn in my bed and cannot sleep. Your recent letter brought such relief: everyone, young and old, is well. Here I have no family nearby, and your health is always on my mind. When I see a father and son together next door, I could weep with envy. I hope to save enough to visit you soon. This page is too short for all I want to say. I wish you peace and good health.
Your son, Ah Fu, with deepest respect
自违慈范，瞬逾三秋: Three autumns have passed since I last saw you.
接奉手谕，知家中大小平安: Your letter tells me everyone at home is well.
每见邻家父子团圆，辄羡极欲泪: When I see a father and son together next door, I could weep with envy.
惟望早积余资，得以早日归省: I hope to save enough to visit you soon.
纸短情长，难尽欲言: This page is too short for all I want to say.
在外打拼的父亲叮嘱子女用心向学: A father working abroad writes to encourage his child at school.
吾儿收知：\n父在外洋，身体如常，请勿挂念。闻尔近日学业颇有进境，甚慰吾心。读书:
My dear child,
My health is as usual here overseas. I was glad to hear how much progress you have made at school. Your studies matter greatly. Do not let our poverty discourage you, or ease up because nobody is watching. Though I am far away, your lessons are never far from my thoughts. With a willing heart, even a difficult task is possible. If I can put enough by, I may come home next year. Then you can show me what you have learned. Keep up the good work.
Your father, Ah Fu
父在外洋，身体如常: My health is as usual here overseas.
闻尔近日学业颇有进境: I hear you have made good progress at school.
天下无难事，只怕有心人: With a willing heart, even a difficult task is possible.
告知家人更换工作的情况，让家人放心: Tell your family about a change of work and put their minds at ease.
双亲大人膝下：\n敬禀者，前函谅已收悉。兹有要事奉告：男已于上月辞去旧东家之事，:
My dear parents,
I trust my last letter reached you. I have some news: last month I left my old employer and took a position with a foreign trading firm. The pay is a little better, my colleagues are kind and the work is manageable. Please do not worry. My address is the same, so your letters will still reach me there. I will tell you more next time. Wishing you peace and good health.
Your son, Ah Fu, with deepest respect
前函谅已收悉: I trust my last letter reached you.
已于上月辞去旧东家之事: Last month I left my old employer.
月薪稍增，同事和善: The pay is a little better and my colleagues are kind.
地址仍旧，赐示仍寄原处: My address is the same. Please write to me there.
为父亲寿辰遥寄祝福和寿礼: Send your father a birthday greeting and a gift from overseas.
父亲大人尊前：\n敬禀者，欣悉本月廿日为大人华诞良辰，男远在异邦，未能趋庭叩祝，:
My honoured father,
I am happy to think of your birthday on the twentieth of this month. It grieves me that I cannot be there to bow before you and offer my good wishes in person. I send twenty dollars as a small token of my love. Please accept it with a smile. May your good fortune be as vast as the Eastern Sea and your life as long as the Southern Mountains. I send my birthday wishes with deepest respect.
Your son, Ah Fu
欣悉本月廿日为大人华诞良辰: I am happy to think of your birthday on the twentieth of this month.
未能趋庭叩祝，殊深负罪: It grieves me that I cannot offer my wishes in person.
汇上寿仪弍拾大元: I send twenty dollars as a birthday gift.
福如东海，寿比南山: May your good fortune be as vast as the Eastern Sea and your life as long as the Southern Mountains.
给妻子的平安家书: A letter to reassure a wife
在外打工的丈夫给妻子报平安，表达牵挂: A husband working abroad sends news and asks after his family.
贤妻妆次：\n启者，自抵叻埠以来，倏已一月有余。此间水土尚合，诸事粗安，幸勿锦注:
My dear wife,
More than a month has passed since I arrived in Singapore. The climate agrees with me and I am doing well. I hope everyone at home is in good health. I heard your mother had been unwell. Has she recovered? Please let me know. My own mother is growing old too, and I am grateful to you for looking after her meals and rest. I spend as little as I can and will send money as soon as I have saved some. In the quiet of the night I think of home and wonder when I shall return. Take good care of yourself.
Your husband, Ah Fu
自抵叻埠以来，倏已一月有余: More than a month has passed since I arrived in Singapore.
闻岳母前日微恙: I heard your mother had been unwell.
望吾妻多用精神照顾: I am grateful to you for looking after her.
夜阑人静，每思家室: In the quiet of the night I think of home.
